steps.name: Install the maintained Python validator closure
Stage the unchanged pinned Python prefix
steps.run:
image='python@sha256:4c2cf9917bd1cbacc5e9b07320025bdb7cdf2df7b0ceaccb55e9dd7e30987419'
container=$(docker create "$image")
trap 'docker rm "$container"' EXIT
prefix="$RUNNER_TEMP/local-service-cpython"
mkdir "$prefix"
docker cp "$container:/usr/local/." "$prefix"
printf 'LSF_LOCAL_PYTHON_PREFIX=%s\n' "$prefix" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Diagnose only the original local-service fixture
Preserve original failure and bounded command evidence

with.name: local-service-refusal-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/local-service-refusal/public/NODE-LOCAL-SERVICE-REFUSAL.json
${{ runner.temp }}/local-service-refusal/public/commands/*.stdout
${{ runner.temp }}/local-service-refusal/public/commands/*.stderr
${{ runner.temp }}/local-service-refusal/public/fixture/observation.json
${{ runner.temp }}/local-service-refusal/public/fixture/node/probe.json
${{ runner.temp }}/local-service-refusal/public/fixture/node/node-tests.json
${{ runner.temp }}/local-service-refusal/public/source-node.json

reviewReason: Reviewed security fork identities only; commands, permissions, inputs, conditions and historical coverage are preserved.
